intermediate.name: Côte de Larringes
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Côte de Larringes (9.7 km)

story: Remco Evenepoel excelled in Stage 16 ITT of the 2026 Tour de France, outpacing Tadej Pogacar by 28 seconds with a time of 32:19. Two incidents impacted the start: Brandon McNulty was hit by a car uninjured, and Thymen Arensman lost time arriving late. Florian Lipowitz withdrew after a crash. Pogacar’s overall lead narrows but remains strong.
